Hi Alex — thanks, this is clear and achievable. Draft plan attached and quick summary below.

Attachments: payflux-load-plan-v1.csv (workload definition), run-instructions.md (test ops checklist)

Summary (high level):
- Proposed test window options: Thu 10/07 14:00–15:00 PDT OR Fri 10/08 09:00–10:00 PDT
- Phases:
  1) Warm-up (5m): ramp to 50% of target load to populate caches
  2) Ramp (10m): linearly increase to 250 concurrent QPS-style requests using the checkout prompt distribution
  3) Steady-state (30m): maintain 250 concurrent; capture per-request latency, KV hit rate, error types
  4) Degraded mode (10m): introduce 20% long context requests to validate graceful degradation
  5) Cooldown (5m): drain and collect final artifacts
- Acceptance metrics to be collected: per-token and per-request latency distributions, CPU/GPU utilization, batch sizes, KV cache hit ratio, transient error logs
- Artifacts we will provide: results-summary-20271007.csv, latency-traces-20271007.zip, full-run raw logs (S3 link)

Operational notes: please confirm the IP ranges listed in the plan for ingress and the sample payloads in the attached CSV; we will need to whitelist PayFlux load generators ahead of the run. Also confirm which service account (if any) PayFlux will use to pull artifacts after the run.

If the windows look good, we can lock in Thu 10/07 14:00 PDT and I will book a 30-minute post-run readout with your team.

Cheers,

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@payflux.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Results: PayFlux acceptance run (Thu 10/07)

Alex / Samantha / Ben — thanks for running the load window yesterday. Quick summary of what we saw and artifacts attached. Full CSVs and traces are in the Drive link above.

Attachments: results-summary-20271007.csv, latency-traces-20271007.zip

Key outcomes (steady-state 30m):
- P95 latency (checkout prompt, measured at Redwood ingress): 172ms
- P99 latency: 310ms (spike at 18:03:12 correlated with a transient GC on node pool 4)
- Success rate: 99.93% (10 transient 5xx across 7.2k requests)
- Average batch size: 8 requests
- KV cache hit ratio: 84% (after warm-up)
- GPU utilization: 62% average; burst to 89% during 20% long-context phase

Notes & action items:
- We captured full per-request traces; one tail spike coincides with degraded-mode long-context requests and a concurrent infra task. We suggest bumping tail capacity by reserving an extra instance during the degraded phase for the production rollout.
- Error analysis attached in CSV: 7 of 10 transient errors were network timeouts between inference host and model shard; ops will attach more verbose logs to the Drive folder.
- Next step: Camila to create the acceptance signoff doc if PayFlux is comfortable with outcomes. Ben to share recommended reserved instance sizing for rollout.

Provisional acceptance status: PASS (meets stated P95 and throughput objectives; minor tail behavior documented).

Camila
